name: Vex Mythoclast

frame.name: Timeless Mythoclast
frame.description: This weapon fires singular bolts in full auto. When the magazine is emptied, ammo is pulled from across timelines to refill it based on the number of shots landed.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Volatile Battery
perks.description:
This battery simultaneously exists in multiple timelines, causing the weapon to Overcharge.

  •  Greatly increases magazine size

perks.name: Temporal Unlimiter
perks.description:
Defeating targets builds stacks of Overcharge.

[Alternate Weapon Action]  : When fully Overcharged, swap firing modes. In this mode, hold the trigger to charge up and fire Linear Fusion Rifle shots that cause an ignition on precision final blows.

perks.name: Hand-Laid Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability

flavor: …a causal loop within the weapon's mechanism, suggesting that the firing process somehow binds space and time into…

catalyst.name: Vex Mythoclast Catalyst
catalyst.description: While in full auto mode, final blows or rapid hits with this weapon grant bonus damage, accuracy, and stability for a short duration.
